description: Election Commission - M. H. N. Haseema was selected as the member of the Beruwala P/S - K. S. Silva was elected as the member of the Beruwala P/S
reasoning: This gazette content specifically deals with filling vacancies in a local government body (Beruwala Pradeshiya Sabha) under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It involves the electoral process for local authorities, including the nomination and declaration of elected members to fill seats that became vacant due to death and party membership cessation. This falls squarely under Election Gazettes (Type 7) as it concerns electoral processes and declarations at the local government level.
